questions.question: Moses told Israel that if they returned to the LORD after being banished far away, what would the LORD do for them?

answers.text: Gather them from all the nations

questions.question: Moses told Israel that God's commandment was not up in heaven or across the sea. Where did he say the word was?

answers.text: In their mouth and in their heart
With the priests in the tabernacle
With the elders at the city gate

questions.question: Moses warned Israel that if they turned away to bow down to other gods, what would happen to them?

answers.text: They will wander forty more years
